verification.source_review: Author reviewed native tab lifecycle and popup creation. Destroyed contents are pruned before state reads; tab maps clear before synchronous native close events. OAuth children adopt Electron-supplied WebContents with current session, sandbox, context isolation, webSecurity, no Node/preload and no non-proxied WebRTC UDP. HTTP(S)/about:blank popup allowlist and navigation restrictions remain enforced. Local regression verifies opener, sessionStorage, cookies, postMessage, window.close, missing privileged globals and file-popup rejection. No SQL, shell or HTML injection sinks added.
verification.publication_inventory: Source, synthetic tests, documentation, threat model and package version only; no user profiles, cookies, OAuth codes, credentials or build outputs in Git.
verification.instructions_review: Documentation and threat-model changes contain no exfiltration or prompt-injection instructions.
verification.packaged_regressions: 2 OAuth and sites/native-tab-destruction tests passed against packaged 0.1.4 payload

limitations: Manual source review and automated tests do not prove absence of vulnerabilities.
Live Twitch/Supercell account linking remains unverified; the tested OAuth fixture uses local origins and synthetic state/cookies.
